snippet.title: Bridget Bishop (Sega Saturn hombrew) - Release candidate
snippet.description:
Sega Saturn hombrew game. Made with jo_engine and poneSound. There's still few bugs.

Free donwload: 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1eYDtHkQGlfUkU1l4xBJUrUS5ywHj5lOa/view?usp=sharing

With configurated mednafen emulator included (to run the game, drag the cue file to emulator exe):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ppqvu68xdg9VWrpsBisco5412mvaACtU/view?usp=sharing
